desc: [UPSTREAM + paired static decode] Track explicit T6040 ATC PHY + SN201202x HPM support. The 25F84 AppleT6040TypeCPhy kext byte-proves the full 44-bank map and raw tunable encoding. Its direct 8,580-byte eUSB2 init is exactly decoded: only banks 0/1, six offsets, ordered RMW/reset/event/status/mode sequence. Paired AppleT8150USBXHCI proves host powerLevel=2/options=0x40000/timeout=500, selecting the false/false branch and final mode 2. The target ADT explicitly selects Apple SPMI Gen3 and right-port SN201202x class 10. Paired publishHPMDevices reads six bounded identity windows, but crosses a provider state boundary and readRegs changes timer/transaction state, so no live read census is authorized. Ticket 063 proved DART+xHCI root hubs but no child. Remaining blockers are SN201202x attach/role/orientation/VBUS/repeater ownership plus rollback. No SPMI or live PHY writes are authorized. Exact host-only proofs: done/2026-07-24-t6040-atcphy-kext-bank-map.md, done/2026-07-24-t6040-eusb2-init-sequence.md, and done/2026-07-24-t6040-hpm-spmi-discovery-boundary.md.
